display.purpose: Masthead Balance and largest monetary figures. Always tabular-nums.

headline.purpose: Route mastheads and full-page section titles (.heading-xl).

body.purpose: Primary reading size on lists and forms.

label.purpose: UPPERCASE small-caps captions on Feather Subtle (.label-sm).

mono.purpose: Reserved for code-like fragments; monetary figures use tabular-nums body/display, not mono.

shadows.name: surface-ambient
shadows.purpose: Default surface depth. Hairline top-highlight + offset downward shadow. No halo.

shadows.name: goal-reached-ring
shadows.purpose: Applied to a saving goal card once its target is reached. Same footprint, celebrated with a green hairline ring.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Lifts the modal panel off the canvas because it interrupts the room.

shadows.name: nav-capsule
shadows.purpose: The one visible elevation on a control — the mobile bottom-nav capsule.

motion.name: ease-perch
motion.purpose: The single authored easing across all bespoke motion (masthead-settle, roost-draw).

motion.name: duration-draw
motion.purpose: Roost-line draw-in duration, delayed 220ms so it follows the balance.

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Standard transition for hover color/background changes on controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single indigo action per surface. Steady, thumb-sized.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: #6366f1; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 10px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: normal; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7c7ff5; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.6); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet second choice. Nest fill with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: #17171b; color: #f4f4f5; border: 1px solid #26262c; border-radius: 10px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #35353d; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.6); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Fill-less. Reveals a Nest fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; color: #a1a1aa; border: none; border-radius: 10px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #17171b; color: #f4f4f5; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.6); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Inset field. iOS-zoom-safe on small screens via 16px on small viewports.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-input-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #71717a; } .ds-input-control { height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; background: #17171b; color: #f4f4f5; border: 1px solid #26262c; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input-control::placeholder { color: #71717a; } .ds-input-control:focus { outline: none; border-color: #6366f1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The primary container. Roost fill, Hairline border, ambient depth.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 20px; background: #111114; color: #f4f4f5; border: 1px solid #26262c; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03), 0 14px 32px -22px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #71717a; } .ds-card-amount { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 36px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; color: #10b981; }

components.name: Masthead Balance
components.description: Signature. The moon-on-the-perch surface: radial indigo glow + dashed roost line under the amount.
components.css: .ds-masthead { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 24px; background: radial-gradient(140% 110% at 100% 0%, rgba(99,102,241,0.10) 0%, rgba(99,102,241,0.03) 34%, transparent 62%), #111114; color: #f4f4f5; border: 1px solid #26262c; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03), 0 14px 32px -22px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; animation: ds-masthead-settle 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.2, 1) both; } .ds-masthead-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #71717a; } .ds-masthead-amount { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 36px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; color: #10b981; } .ds-masthead-roost { display: block; height: 1px; margin-top: 6px; width: 40px; opacity: 0.55; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, #6366f1 0, #6366f1 4px, transparent 4px, transparent 8px); animation: ds-roost-draw 360ms 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.2, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-masthead-settle { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } @keyframes ds-roost-draw { from { width: 0; opacity: 0; } to { width: 40px; opacity: 0.55; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-masthead, .ds-masthead-roost { animation: none; } }

components.name: Delta Pill
components.description: Micro-card showing month-over-month movement. Semantic tone rides the direction.
components.html: Income↑ 12%vs last month
components.css: .ds-delta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 10px 12px; background: #111114; color: #f4f4f5; border: 1px solid #26262c; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03), 0 14px 32px -22px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; min-width: 0; } .ds-delta-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #71717a; } .ds-delta-value { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-delta-up { color: #10b981; } .ds-delta-down { color: #f43f5e; } .ds-delta-flat { color: #a1a1aa; } .ds-delta-caption { font-size: 10px; color: #71717a; }

components.name: Semantic Chip — Income
components.description: Soft-tone pill. One per money kind. Never used for non-monetary status.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-chip-income { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.094); color: #10b981; border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.3); }

components.name: Category Well
components.description: A round tinted well with 1–2 uppercase category initials.
components.css: .ds-well { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid; user-select: none; } .ds-well-sm { width: 32px; height: 32px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-well-md { width: 44px; height: 44px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-well-lg { width: 56px; height: 56px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-well-neutral { background: #17171b; border-color: #26262c; color: #f4f4f5; } .ds-well-income { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.094); border-color: rgba(16,185,129,0.3); color: #10b981; } .ds-well-expense { background: rgba(244,63,94,0.094); border-color: rgba(244,63,94,0.3); color: #f43f5e; } .ds-well-invest { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.094); border-color: rgba(245,158,11,0.3); color: #f59e0b; } .ds-well-accent { background: rgba(99,102,241,0.10); border-color: rgba(99,102,241,0.3); color: #6366f1; }

components.name: Bottom Nav (Mobile Capsule)
components.description: Signature. The mobile primary nav collapses to one indigo capsule at the thumb.
components.css: .ds-navbar { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 0; background: rgba(10,10,11,0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-top: 1px solid #26262c; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-capsule { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background: #6366f1; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-capsule:active { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-nav-capsule:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 2px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.6); }

narrative.northStar: The Nightbird's Perch — a moonlit ledger.
narrative.overview:
Perch is a dark, quiet room where money can be looked at without being shouted about. The whole system is built to feel like sitting in a low-lit study after hours: near-black surfaces, hairline borders, and a single indigo light that behaves like the moon on the perch — one authored glow at the top-right of the masthead balance, one dashed accent stroke ("the roost line") that grows in on mount, and then stillness. Semantic income / expense / investment tones are the only colored voices allowed onto the canvas, and they only speak when a number needs to mean something. Nothing performs importance; the figures themselves are the point.

Density is calm, not sparse: money surfaces cluster into fielded cards with generous internal padding, list rows use ample vertical rhythm, and the primary action lives at the thumb on mobile via the bottom-anchored capsule. Motion is authored, brief, and always respectful of prefers-reduced-motion. The aesthetic anti-references are the two forms of dashboard cliché this product exists to reject — the bright-fintech "confetti + candy palette" and the enterprise-BI "metric wall". Perch declines both.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only, near-black canvas with hairline muted borders
One accent (indigo) used sparingly; three semantic tones (income, expense, investment) reserved for money meaning
Signature 'moon on the perch' masthead glow + dashed 'roost line'
Mobile-first PWA rhythm: bottom nav, safe-area aware, tap-friendly

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Indigo appears on at most one non-semantic element per viewport at a time (the primary action, or the active pip, or one moon glow — not several). Its rarity is what makes it read as light, not decoration.

rules.name: The Money-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Ledger Green, Rose, and Amber never appear on non-monetary UI. They are reserved for numbers, transaction kinds, and the direct visual signal of a money movement. Do not use them for status, tags, or emphasis unless the emphasis is about money.

rules.name: The Tabular-Nums Rule
rules.body: Every monetary figure uses tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap. Money columns must align on the decimal without shimmering as digits change.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Only-For-Labels Rule
rules.body: UPPERCASE is reserved for label-sm captions. Headings, buttons, and body copy stay in normal case.

rules.name: The No-Halo Rule
rules.body: No zero-offset glow shadows on cards, buttons, or containers. Depth is authored with offset shadows, not halos, so the room stays quiet.

rules.name: The One-Glow-Per-Surface Rule
rules.body: The masthead balance owns the single radial indigo glow ('moon on the perch'). Do not repeat that device on other cards; it is a hallmark, not a pattern.

dos: Do treat Perch Indigo as light. Use it for the primary action, focus rings, the active nav pip, the PerchMark's eye, and the masthead's radial glow — and mostly nothing else.
Do reserve Ledger Green / Rose / Amber for money meaning. If a color is on the screen, a viewer should be able to point at it and say 'that's about a number'.
Do use tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap on every currency value.
Do describe cards with a 1px Hairline border + the Surface ambient shadow. Fill alone is not enough.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: mask, don't merely shorten, the masthead settle and roost draw.
Do keep the Perch identity (name, tagline 'A quiet place for your money to rest.', PerchMark glyph) intact across surfaces.
donts: Don't introduce halo shadows (0 0 X rgba(...)) on cards, buttons, or containers. Depth is offset, not glow.
Don't paint large surfaces in Perch Indigo (banners, hero fills, backgrounds). It is a spotlight, not a wall.
Don't use semantic money colors for non-monetary status (avoid Ledger Green 'success' toasts, Ledger Rose 'error' banners, etc. — use neutral surfaces with Feather Subtle copy instead).
Don't add a light theme without a product-level decision. Perch is committed dark; color-scheme: dark is set on the root.
Don't stack multiple radial glows on a single viewport. The masthead owns the moon.
Don't repeat capital-letter text outside the label-sm role. Uppercase buttons or uppercase body copy break the calm.
Don't add 'dashboard' chrome: KPI walls, big colored gauges, confetti, streak fires, notification counters. The product's anti-reference is the metric wall.
